title: draw_messages scroll: top can underflow when scroll_offset > total
description: In draw_messages: top = total.saturating_sub(visible_height).saturating_sub(scroll_offset). If scroll_offset is larger than total.saturating_sub(visible_height) the second saturating_sub returns 0 (correct). However, the Paragraph scroll argument is top as u16. If total < visible_height (fewer messages than visible rows) then total.saturating_sub(visible_height)=0 and top=0 regardless of scroll_offset — this is correct. But the real issue is clamp_scroll uses messages.len() (count of raw message strings), while draw_messages uses area.height (pixel rows). If any message wraps onto multiple rows, the user can set scroll_offset large enough that top=0 but the view still shows the wrong messages — the clamp is logically correct for unwrapped messages but wrong for wrapped ones. This is the underlying correctness issue for KITH-hqrw.17.
